messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Automatically calling more than 1 QTL per LG to make qtlobject for fitqtl
parts:
I'd recommend moving to multiple-QTL methods, either fully automated, with stepwiseqtl(),
or more "by hand", with makeqtl() and addqtl().

karl


On Mar 29, 2014, at 4:56 PM, Keith <freew...@gmail.com> wrote:

> Is there some way to automatically call more than 1 QTL per chromosome?
>
> Right now I am using summary(crossobject,threshold=3.##) method
>
> However, this only lists the marker with the highest LOD from each chromosome. Is calling more than 1 qtl per chromosome an entirely manual process or are there functions I can use to automate it?
>
